purpose: This form is used by a company incorporated or to be incorporated outside India to issue Indian Depository Receipts (IDRs).
who: A company incorporated or to be incorporated outside India
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Obtain necessary approvals or exemptions from the appropriate authorities in the country of incorporation.
Obtain prior written approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India for the issue of IDRs and the issue size.
checklist: Verify pre-issue paid-up capital and free reserves are at least US$ 50 million.
Verify minimum average market capitalization of at least US$ 100 million during the last three years.
Confirm continuous trading on a stock exchange in the parent or home country for at least three immediately preceding years.
Check for a track record of distributable profits for at least three out of the immediately preceding five years.
Ensure compliance with SEBI regulations and RBI directions.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
